You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH director_movie_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(m.duration) as total_movie_duration,
        AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
        SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    LEFT JOIN ratings r ON m.id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name
),
movie_year_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        m.year,
        LAG(m.year) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.year) as prev_year
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
inter_movie_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        AVG(year - prev_year) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM movie_year_with_lag
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    dms.name_id,
    dms.name,
    dms.movie_count,
    ROUND(dim.avg_inter_movie_duration) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(dms.avg_rating, 2) as avg_rating,
    dms.total_votes,
    dms.min_rating,
    dms.max_rating,
    dms.total_movie_duration
FROM director_movie_stats dms
JOIN inter_movie_duration dim ON dms.name_id = dim.name_id
ORDER BY dms.movie_count DESC, dms.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(m.duration) as total_duration,
        AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
        SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
    GROUP BY dm.name_id, n.name
),
movie_intervals AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        LAG(m.year) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.year, m.date_published) as prev_year,
        m.year
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
director_intervals AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        COUNT(*) as interval_count,
        AVG(year - prev_year) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM movie_intervals
    WHERE prev_year IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT 
    ds.name_id,
    ds.name,
    ds.movie_count,
    ROUND(dia.avg_inter_movie_duration) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(ds.avg_rating, 2) as avg_rating,
    ds.total_votes,
    ds.min_rating,
    ds.max_rating,
    ds.total_duration
FROM director_stats ds
JOIN director_intervals dia ON ds.name_id = dia.name_id
ORDER BY ds.movie_count DESC, ds.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name as director_name,
        m.id as movie_id,
        CAST(m.date_published AS DATE) as pub_date,
        m.duration as movie_duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
),
director_with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        director_name,
        pub_date,
        LAG(pub_date) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY pub_date) as prev_date,
        movie_duration,
        avg_rating,
        total_votes,
        CASE WHEN prev_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(pub_date AS DATE) - CAST(prev_date AS DATE) ELSE NULL END as days_diff
    FROM director_movies
)
SELECT 
    name_id,
    director_name,
    movie_count,
    ROUND(CAST(avg_inter_duration AS INTEGER)) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    min_rating,
    max_rating,
    total_movie_duration
FROM (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        director_name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(movie_duration) as total_movie_duration,
        ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) as avg_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        AVG(days_diff) as avg_inter_duration
    FROM director_with_lag
